Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
6:35 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor. That matters more than a fancy graphics card.

RAM: 16 GB is the minimum for code editors, browsers and Docker together. 32 GB is only worth it for heavy work like big builds or running AI locally.
Processor: A recent Ryzen 5 or 7, Intel Core i5 or Ultra 5, or an Apple M-series chip all run code tools well.
Screen and keyboard: Pick a 14 to 16 inch screen at 1920×1200 or better, with a comfortable keyboard. You'll look at both all day.
Battery: Look for 8+ hours of real use if you work away from a socket.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you do game development or train AI AI.
